configurePresets.name: host-simulator
configurePresets.description: Native Linux build of the Ravine Phoenix HAL for the desktop simulator. Compiles the shared HAL sources (hal/, boards/, common/) together with the SDL2 backends in src/backend_sim/, and links SDL2 for the window/input and OpenSSL for TLS and Ed25519. Completely separate from the ESP-IDF firmware build: this preset has its own source directory (sim/) and binary directory (build-sim/), and the firmware presets in the repository-root CMakePresets.json are unaffected. Also listed in the root CMakePresets.json via an "include", so CLion offers it in the same CMake profile list as the firmware targets.

configurePresets.name: host-simulator-release
configurePresets.description: Optimised build of the host simulator. Same sources as host-simulator, with -O2 and no debug info.
